about: Touchdown zone lights on runways whose thresholds are less than 6000 ft apart (issue #72): X-Plane 12 and SEDX at night, from above, to count the barrette rows per end. Views computed from the global apt.dat runway rows; regenerate with the script in the issue if they move.
